788b70c94e8c5305a0d3c079bbaa2740c5437cb9.source: 视频教程：<s id="0">观看本章视频</s>。
788b70c94e8c5305a0d3c079bbaa2740c5437cb9.translation: Video tutorial: <s id="0">watch this chapter's video</s>.

8d69ae6c5f65df6243d99080015cbbba70eeeb0a.source: 在这里浏览、查找和输入 IPA、extIPA、VoQS，也能查看记号的用法与来源。三套表共用下方文本框，可混合输入音段、附加号、声调和音质范围。文字只在本机编辑。
8d69ae6c5f65df6243d99080015cbbba70eeeb0a.translation: Browse, find, and enter IPA, extIPA, and VoQS, and inspect their usage and sources. All three charts share the text box below, where you can mix segments, diacritics, tones, and voice-quality spans. Text is edited locally only.

6c2692550d8bdc193684296b382a2cf4c2d44b82.source: 打开<s id="0">国际音标表Plus</s>，等待读取草稿结束。首次是空文本；已有草稿会恢复正文与设置。
6c2692550d8bdc193684296b382a2cf4c2d44b82.translation: Open <s id="0">IPA Chart Plus</s> and wait for draft loading to finish. First use starts empty; an existing draft restores text and settings.

f0b46c53d320207f5a2703e3a904935b255e81e9.source: 在下方文本框输入或粘贴文字，<s id="0">先放好光标或选中待替换内容</s>，再点图表中的符号。
f0b46c53d320207f5a2703e3a904935b255e81e9.translation: Type or paste in the lower text box. <s id="0">Position the cursor or select the text to replace first</s>, then click a chart symbol.

18a26a4316b642146be3c88b0b29946ad4403b3c.source: 选体系：一般音段和韵律用 <s id="0">IPA</s>，额外构音、部分发声、无声构音或外来噪声查 <s id="1">extIPA</s>，一段言语的音质设置查 <s id="2">VoQS</s>。
18a26a4316b642146be3c88b0b29946ad4403b3c.translation: Choose <s id="0">IPA</s> for general segments and prosody, <s id="1">extIPA</s> for additional articulation, partial voicing, silent articulation, or external noise, and <s id="2">VoQS</s> for voice-quality settings across a speech span.

9a5c3c01a9172cad1914758e27f6d57ad8bb1729.source: <s id="0">当前点击播放暂不可用，点符号即可输入文字。</s>
9a5c3c01a9172cad1914758e27f6d57ad8bb1729.translation: <s id="0">Click-to-play is currently unavailable. Clicking a symbol enters text.</s>

16d36ee5835f90d66950bfaa499b292fb3643adf.source: 音标使用随模块提供的 PTB IPA Plus 字体，无须另装系统字体；中文沿用应用字体。底部显示<s id="0">固定字体就绪</s>后可核对附加号。桌面资源随应用提供；网页加载完成后可断网编辑，关闭后再离线打开可能无法载入。
16d36ee5835f90d66950bfaa499b292fb3643adf.translation: IPA uses the bundled PTB IPA Plus font; no system installation is needed. Chinese uses the app font. Check diacritics after <s id="0">Fixed font ready</s> appears at the bottom. Desktop resources are bundled. Once the web page loads, you can disconnect and edit; reopening offline after closing may fail to load.

5432a2b807b7bbd46f03e456b4f549d5d881b46f.source: 三套表有 625 个入口：IPA 351、extIPA 209、VoQS 65，入口包含组合、例示和工具。
5432a2b807b7bbd46f03e456b4f549d5d881b46f.translation: The three charts contain 625 entries: IPA 351, extIPA 209, and VoQS 65, including combinations, examples, and tools.

15924d5c7d23d850e4bceb89b259fcddb3b60ad0.source: IPA 基础图表：顶部工具、中部辅音矩阵、右侧元音图与下方文本框。
15924d5c7d23d850e4bceb89b259fcddb3b60ad0.translation: IPA basic chart: tools at the top, a consonant matrix in the middle, a vowel chart on the right, and the text box below.

46ad697b06f07662424585c113e3904b7b2506ae.source: 查表、检索和看介绍都会保留正文。表区可上下、左右滚动；文本较多时，向上拖文本框上沿的分隔条，让更多行露出来。
46ad697b06f07662424585c113e3904b7b2506ae.translation: Browsing, searching, and reading descriptions retain your text. Scroll charts vertically or horizontally. For longer text, drag the divider above the text box upward to show more lines.

7f41debdb9898a8a660948eca870c66ebd2e84a9.source: 切体系、检索、改字号和开关悬停介绍；点击播放暂不可用，右侧是帮助和方法与引用。
7f41debdb9898a8a660948eca870c66ebd2e84a9.translation: Switch systems, search, change size, and toggle hover descriptions. Click-to-play is unavailable. Help and Methods and references are on the right.

40b395206a24c87247411c61f0076d6e8586a49e.source: 显示表版与输入提示；IPA、extIPA 默认显示全部，也可选择分区。
40b395206a24c87247411c61f0076d6e8586a49e.translation: Shows chart edition and input hints. IPA and extIPA initially show all sections; individual sections can be selected.

8e610147d9175dacfd0bd558d0d33af93e71e400.source: 浏览矩阵、元音图或分类记号，点击输入，右键看详情。
8e610147d9175dacfd0bd558d0d33af93e71e400.translation: Browse matrices, the vowel chart, or categorized symbols. Click to enter; right-click for details.

2ebe81355291e13098ce8566269f0ad8327edb3c.source: 手动输入、粘贴、选区编辑；上沿分隔条可调高度。
2ebe81355291e13098ce8566269f0ad8327edb3c.translation: Type, paste, and edit selections. Resize using the divider above.

899455be77829e9c93035520318bfbd2db82b84e.source: 复制、全选、撤销、重做、保存、清空，以及草稿、字体和码位提示。
899455be77829e9c93035520318bfbd2db82b84e.translation: Copy, select all, undo, redo, save, and clear, plus draft, font, and code-point information.

2090746312e26fd2c270a082cb09b158eb77a432.source: 悬停速览，右键或 Alt+Enter 固定展开；有演示素材时也在这里显示。
2090746312e26fd2c270a082cb09b158eb77a432.translation: Hover for a preview; right-click or Alt+Enter to pin details. Demonstration media, where available, also appear here.

343714142e8be55101cf35278a868d1d65ef81ca.source: 在 <s id="0">IPA → 基础图表</s>的元音图点 <s id="1">a</s>，下方出现 a。
343714142e8be55101cf35278a868d1d65ef81ca.translation: In the vowel chart under <s id="0">IPA → Basic chart</s>, click <s id="1">a</s>. a appears below.

7f3b0a3b2f8e6e7f1ec2c12492ffd2657498c37a.source: 搜索<s id="0">鼻化</s>。把光标放到 a 后，<s id="1">取消选区</s>，点深色 ◌̃，得到 ã。
7f3b0a3b2f8e6e7f1ec2c12492ffd2657498c37a.translation: Search for <s id="0">鼻化</s>. Place the cursor after a, <s id="1">clear the selection</s>, then click dark ◌̃ to obtain ã.

496607042c79f84467604f1e984db9401bb2855e.source: 选中整个 ã，再点另一普通符号或完整例示，会替换这段文字。点<s id="0">撤销</s>可恢复。
496607042c79f84467604f1e984db9401bb2855e.translation: Select all of ã, then click another ordinary symbol or complete example to replace it. <s id="0">Undo</s> restores it.

a1a3e79344ae9e64d3df8b49620ec658273b1360.source: <s id="0">悬停或右键符号</s>查看用法与实际输入；看完可收起详情。
a1a3e79344ae9e64d3df8b49620ec658273b1360.translation: <s id="0">Hover over or right-click a symbol</s> to inspect usage and actual input. Collapse details when finished.

be297d72b1e21edbed320e8c129aac418a3f7ab8.source: 点<s id="0">复制全部</s>粘贴到目标文档，或点<s id="1">保存文本</s>下载 TXT。核对字符和实际文件后再离开。
be297d72b1e21edbed320e8c129aac418a3f7ab8.translation: Click <s id="0">Copy all</s> and paste into the destination document, or <s id="1">Save text</s> to download TXT. Check characters and the actual file before leaving.

2829af02c7aa26ba3593249eeee66dcbca731881.source: 浅色按钮会输入完整例示。例如 ẽ 会整串写入并替换选区，不会只给原字母加鼻化。
2829af02c7aa26ba3593249eeee66dcbca731881.translation: Light buttons enter complete examples. For instance, ẽ inserts the whole string and replaces a selection; it does not merely nasalize an existing letter.

943e0524f91455d62b3c5ecbf7f745ecbd6fb216.translation: Finding an item when search fails

2478f2f0ff525dafbf550811f9f0132310c57166.source: 先选 <s id="0">IPA / extIPA / VoQS</s>，检索只在当前体系内进行。
2478f2f0ff525dafbf550811f9f0132310c57166.translation: Choose <s id="0">IPA / extIPA / VoQS</s> first. Searches are limited to the current system.

1e5e60d3cebe867ea2837d90e660cd3d72e058fa.source: 输入符号、中英文名称、<s id="0">U+1DF06</s> 形式的码位或已有 CIN 别名。支持部分词匹配，不区分英文大小写。
1e5e60d3cebe867ea2837d90e660cd3d72e058fa.translation: Enter a symbol, Chinese or English name, code point such as <s id="0">U+1DF06</s>, or an existing CIN alias. Partial matches are supported and English is case-insensitive.

c38cdcc2404d964119a49a8c148674fe9215afa5.source: 核对<s id="0">找到项数、名称与当前体系</s>后再点结果。搜索时分区按钮隐藏。
c38cdcc2404d964119a49a8c148674fe9215afa5.translation: Check the <s id="0">match count, names, and current system</s> before clicking a result. Section buttons are hidden during search.

3dafd1a176fa3ba1491278f8ac52dcd8b8ff884c.source: <s id="0">清空搜索</s>返回原分区。换体系后搜索词仍在，需要重新核对结果。
3dafd1a176fa3ba1491278f8ac52dcd8b8ff884c.translation: <s id="0">Clear search</s> returns to the previous section. The query remains after switching systems; check the new results.

2dff10b7558a1b9621dfc857d2ed606e73b03177.source: 搜索 U+0062 后，IPA 结果显示浊双唇爆发音 b，下方选中的 ã 已替换为 b。
2dff10b7558a1b9621dfc857d2ed606e73b03177.translation: Searching U+0062 in IPA finds voiced bilabial plosive b. The selected ã below has been replaced by b.

e6c3bb8c6da35336adc48e25df83b6ef8d67cd7a.source: 下列为没有草稿时的默认值。已有草稿会恢复体系、悬停介绍、字号和文本框高度；搜索词、分区页、播放开关、详情和撤销历史不恢复。
e6c3bb8c6da35336adc48e25df83b6ef8d67cd7a.translation: The following defaults apply without a draft. Existing drafts restore system, hover descriptions, size, and text-box height. Query, section page, playback switch, details, and undo history are not restored.

e3237112ccbff6b83d4619b9709deedab3620064.source: 换表与检索范围，保留正文、光标和当前撤销历史。
e3237112ccbff6b83d4619b9709deedab3620064.translation: Changes chart and search scope while retaining text, cursor, and current undo history.

91699f95d1454aba76e7a52c9db614aa04545a66.source: IPA 与 extIPA 均为显示全部
91699f95d1454aba76e7a52c9db614aa04545a66.translation: Show all for both IPA and extIPA

5888764019e814f5e597875656d53d483cae172c.source: IPA 两页、extIPA 四页；VoQS 直接分类。搜索非空时隐藏。
5888764019e814f5e597875656d53d483cae172c.translation: IPA has two pages; extIPA has four. VoQS shows categories directly. Hidden when the query is nonempty.

9b4c7e9da0afd528660f56c4a5da90a6fcadef72.source: <s id="0">符号 / 名称 / U+ / CIN</s>

c72df5e77d7455a4baee498f978205438fddb2a4.source: 查显示字符、实际输入、名称、码位和别名。
c72df5e77d7455a4baee498f978205438fddb2a4.translation: Searches display characters, actual input, names, code points, and aliases.

a309e8a7ceb2afdc82a7784af26266ccb44701fa.source: 同时调整图表和文本框。普通符号通常比设定值小 6px，例示会再缩小；名称字号不变。
a309e8a7ceb2afdc82a7784af26266ccb44701fa.translation: Changes charts and text together. Ordinary symbols are usually 6 px smaller than the setting, and examples smaller still; name size stays unchanged.

0f5e7f4310d284e028c045b54e0b50e5e0a60dd4.source: 自动显示说明；关闭后仍可右键或 Alt+Enter 看详情。
0f5e7f4310d284e028c045b54e0b50e5e0a60dd4.translation: Shows descriptions automatically. When off, right-click or Alt+Enter still opens details.

0f822e57e74a58f6915ffd37b56a0ebb7c91c82b.source: 演示内容正在创作中，悬停可查看提示；当前点击符号用于输入。
0f822e57e74a58f6915ffd37b56a0ebb7c91c82b.translation: Demonstration content is being created. Hover for the notice; clicking symbols currently enters text.

207a2343c8a796f76fd158cf93f279c82126ee13.source: 进入本章，点返回 国际音标表Plus 回到原正文和选区。
207a2343c8a796f76fd158cf93f279c82126ee13.translation: Opens this chapter. Return to IPA Chart Plus restores the previous text and selection.

fa947aad50d8d0906843aaee5100a3842e1796df.source: 查看出处与许可、复制引用、主动打开公开链接。
fa947aad50d8d0906843aaee5100a3842e1796df.translation: View sources and licenses, copy citations, or actively open public links.

fa6b49f0d5b1543d1b5ec37c49d928391f1393ea.source: 本模块说明书的目录、搜索与右上返回 国际音标表Plus 按钮。
fa6b49f0d5b1543d1b5ec37c49d928391f1393ea.translation: This module's manual contents, search, and Return to IPA Chart Plus button at the upper right.

0fbb7e401b92f2fce1edb70ecc3ac73a13eb9174.source: 字号提交时取整并限制在 18–54，空值或无效值恢复 26。它只改变显示，正文字符和导出编码保持原样。页面缩放与应用基础字号在全局设置中调整。
0fbb7e401b92f2fce1edb70ecc3ac73a13eb9174.translation: On submission, font size is rounded and clamped to 18–54. Empty or invalid input resets to 26. It affects display only; text characters and export encoding stay unchanged. Adjust page zoom and app base size in global settings.

3c97c7120d7e013dd8aa54cd82a33f89442e67b5.source: 支持手动输入、粘贴、中文和换行。读取草稿时暂不可输入。
3c97c7120d7e013dd8aa54cd82a33f89442e67b5.translation: Supports typing, pasting, Chinese, and newlines. Input is temporarily disabled while loading a draft.

c0ca9deb922e1f90e5083505e43cccdcbfa5962f.source: 默认 120px，范围 96–360。向上拖加高；聚焦后 ↑/↓ 每次调 16px，Home 最小、End 最大。
c0ca9deb922e1f90e5083505e43cccdcbfa5962f.translation: Default 120 px, range 96–360. Drag upward to increase height. When focused, ↑/↓ changes it by 16 px, Home minimizes, and End maximizes.

9bed61d044eaba80b79fc3ae12dad928bff1fec6.source: 复制整份正文；空文本给提示。全选用于替换、包围范围或手工复制。
9bed61d044eaba80b79fc3ae12dad928bff1fec6.translation: Copies the whole text, with a notice if empty. Select all is useful for replacement, span wrapping, or manual copying.

bb5f50693a24d8d4ffc93017de4825583a1ff97d.source: Ctrl/⌘+Z 撤销，Ctrl/⌘+Shift+Z 或 Ctrl+Y 重做。没有历史时禁用；撤销后新编辑会清掉重做分支。
bb5f50693a24d8d4ffc93017de4825583a1ff97d.translation: Ctrl/⌘+Z undoes; Ctrl/⌘+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y redoes. Disabled without history. Editing after undo clears the redo branch.

c3f4f761a4ea9fd56b4d8422e6df4ee2fd042f57.source: 发起 UTF-8 TXT 下载，空正文也可保存。
c3f4f761a4ea9fd56b4d8422e6df4ee2fd042f57.translation: Starts a UTF-8 TXT download. Empty text can also be saved.

6736c30589c2759ae2d4e3838dbcf533ce267b29.source: 空文本时禁用。清空可撤销，已经导出的文件保留。
6736c30589c2759ae2d4e3838dbcf533ce267b29.translation: Disabled for empty text. Clearing can be undone; exported files remain.

cbbfec44eb5e53fbe91393862e76322a856100d9.source: 草稿错误提示中出现，用来保护当前正文；仍需同时导出 TXT。
cbbfec44eb5e53fbe91393862e76322a856100d9.translation: Appears in draft-error messages to protect current text. Export TXT as well.

1f5816deafa222507ea192344e2fb753a5b6d986.source: 按实际输入写入光标处或替换选区，也可能是组合记号。
1f5816deafa222507ea192344e2fb753a5b6d986.translation: Writes actual input at the cursor or replaces the selection; it may be a combined symbol.

f0ca9c365a05409ae279d2c62993d82ecd473d03.source: 点击可一次输入整串组合字符。
f0ca9c365a05409ae279d2c62993d82ecd473d03.translation: Click to enter the entire combined string at once.

59c8e8d799531d878bc03c3c30edc5a9b0e158e0.source: 名称简释 / 悬停介绍

40323d57ca485374fece8e51332b195784e3fcc1.source: 悬停名称看简释；符号悬停或键盘聚焦约 420ms 后显示介绍，可移入阅读、滚动。
40323d57ca485374fece8e51332b195784e3fcc1.translation: Hover over a name for a brief gloss. Hovering over a symbol or focusing it for about 420 ms shows a description you can enter, read, and scroll.

2cbaf9bd1eb5d5272b0632ae3afbc67e576fc233.source: 右键符号，或 Tab 聚焦后按 Alt+Enter，固定展开详情。
2cbaf9bd1eb5d5272b0632ae3afbc67e576fc233.translation: Right-click a symbol, or focus with Tab and press Alt+Enter, to pin its details.

4dfe22187bda0bf7da318d149a6729840570031a.translation: Inserts the current item into the editor.

5028bfb700a7e9a49ef80917a164a46addc15e45.source: 左下关于 → 内置字体版权与许可 → PTB IPA Plus；窗口默认先显示 Doulos SIL。
5028bfb700a7e9a49ef80917a164a46addc15e45.translation: Bottom-left About → Bundled font copyright and licenses → PTB IPA Plus. The window initially shows Doulos SIL.

3d479d89508933abfc06647199106a4becaddee7.source: 读取结束后可编辑；改动显示未保存，写入成功才显示已保存。
3d479d89508933abfc06647199106a4becaddee7.translation: Editing starts after loading. Changes show Unsaved; Saved appears only after a successful write.

36f21d0a02a66bb8a9acf78ef08ae0e9e79f46d9.source: 按 Unicode 码点计数，字母和附加号可能各占一项。
36f21d0a02a66bb8a9acf78ef08ae0e9e79f46d9.translation: Counts Unicode code points; a letter and its diacritic may count separately.

17e3491369447dc17d1a5076021c994cec418501.source: 固定字体就绪 / 字体加载中

35cdbe263d513fab2cca7af665385765a814113b.source: 显示字体载入状态，失败会报错。
35cdbe263d513fab2cca7af665385765a814113b.translation: Shows font loading status; failure produces an error.

df3e45ea8ff3079bd675134fe41e3eb223c35064.source: 选择不超过 8 个码点的短片段，底部显示 U+ 序列。
df3e45ea8ff3079bd675134fe41e3eb223c35064.translation: Select a short span of at most 8 code points to display its U+ sequence below.

8f442137618bf8af75b4d6d1b59e4e201caa4511.source: 列出数量及前几项位置，原文保留，不会自动清理。
8f442137618bf8af75b4d6d1b59e4e201caa4511.translation: Shows their count and the first few positions. The original text is retained without automatic cleanup.

10a6b7ca0ee6c6c89bbeaef856f037a4a42d152f.source: 显示复制、下载、输入法或组合操作的结果。发起下载后还需检查文件。
10a6b7ca0ee6c6c89bbeaef856f037a4a42d152f.translation: Shows results of copying, downloading, input-method, or combination actions. Check the file after starting a download.

e2f7247104aaf5b6838e0ab7b60c160d16e9210a.translation: The three charts and combined input

134312fcd6b35f4a17431b7abec552de428aa01d.source: 在<s id="0">基础图表</s>按辅音方式与部位找符号，或到元音图定位。同格多个按钮先核对名称和清浊。
134312fcd6b35f4a17431b7abec552de428aa01d.translation: In <s id="0">Basic chart</s>, locate consonants by manner and place, or locate vowels in the vowel chart. Where several buttons share a cell, check names and voicing first.

0750db213560fa55e9a0c4b105da32e6c1ece377.source: 需要鼻化、送气、声调或韵律记号时，切到<s id="0">附加符号与韵律</s>。深色附加号放在基底后，浅色按钮输入完整例示。
0750db213560fa55e9a0c4b105da32e6c1ece377.translation: For nasalization, aspiration, tones, or prosodic marks, switch to <s id="0">Diacritics and prosody</s>. Dark diacritics follow a base; light buttons enter complete examples.

4f5bb61135f96689831f19ec8b1ff416ac9dca79.source: 滚动可看屏幕外的条目，右键核对实际输入与来源。分区按钮消失时，<s id="0">清空搜索</s>即可恢复。
4f5bb61135f96689831f19ec8b1ff416ac9dca79.translation: Scroll to see off-screen items and right-click to check actual input and sources. If section buttons disappear, <s id="0">Clear search</s> restores them.

f47ee4b86a81aabb03f890b21a59742494343a01.source: 元音 a 的详细介绍展开，名称、码位与说明可见，下方正文为 a。
f47ee4b86a81aabb03f890b21a59742494343a01.translation: Vowel a details are open, showing name, code points, and description. The text below is a.

cd7d6b3e64c12ccb26cb45248a8584f91fe7e94b.source: 辅音矩阵按 14 个部位、13 种方式排列，包含非肺部辅音与补充组合。需要精确查找时，用名称或码位检索更省事。
cd7d6b3e64c12ccb26cb45248a8584f91fe7e94b.translation: The consonant matrix uses 14 places and 13 manners, including non-pulmonic consonants and supplementary combinations. Searching by name or code point is faster for precise lookup.

f79e00054bd119179f5ddc387c49e59b19cc1d18.source: 空格表示当前未收录入口。标为<s id="0">组合输入示例</s>的条目由既有字母与附加号组成。
f79e00054bd119179f5ddc387c49e59b19cc1d18.translation: An empty cell means no entry is currently included. Items marked <s id="0">Combined-input example</s> use existing letters and diacritics.

55d3213d5219062b224d8b0a48661423c1290bb6.translation: Contents of the two IPA pages

ffb06e2efa14bd7e697be95770c09e4ebb45059d.source: 基础图表的方式×部位矩阵，同格符号分别可点。
ffb06e2efa14bd7e697be95770c09e4ebb45059d.translation: Basic-chart manner × place matrix; symbols within the same cell can be clicked separately.

ae7398bc62ec1c5983fe4f519630166f3adf30bb.source: 按前、央、后与高低排列，成对时左不圆唇、右圆唇。
ae7398bc62ec1c5983fe4f519630166f3adf30bb.translation: Arranged by front, central, back, and height. In pairs, the left is unrounded and the right rounded.

7c8fba0c8e16b181c96f78acca6d65e47acdb7af.source: 区分深色连接工具与浅色 k͡p、t͜s 等完整例示。
7c8fba0c8e16b181c96f78acca6d65e47acdb7af.translation: Distinguish dark joining tools from light complete examples such as k͡p and t͜s.

dd8f490eea146f1a6850d5b4e1480e0522a521a8.source: 独立附加号与完整组合。虚线圆只显示位置。
dd8f490eea146f1a6850d5b4e1480e0522a521a8.translation: Standalone diacritics and complete combinations. The dotted circle indicates placement only.

ac054b2498518536f0376bb29960930a900e24e9.source: 独立记号与组合例示分开；调级是相对等级，不转换为 Hz。
ac054b2498518536f0376bb29960930a900e24e9.translation: Separate marks and combined examples are distinct. Tone levels are relative and are not converted to Hz.

9c5371a6bcd0061d72246301bb251f4b70ce2a8b.source: 重音、长度、音节与韵律边界等，位置依条目说明。
9c5371a6bcd0061d72246301bb251f4b70ce2a8b.translation: Stress, length, syllable, and prosodic boundaries; placement follows each entry's instructions.

7b53f8544a83ecd29f58cb513ebcb7729d7f74dc.source: 宽窗的元音图与其他符号在辅音矩阵右侧，窄窗移到下方。大字号下可横向或纵向滚动。
7b53f8544a83ecd29f58cb513ebcb7729d7f74dc.translation: In wide windows the vowel chart and other symbols sit right of the consonant matrix; in narrow windows they move below. Scroll vertically or horizontally at large font sizes.

8dfd97de16a572c892a77ab2404cbc0e85769a94.source: extIPA 提供额外构音、部分发声、节奏、不确定片段及外来声音记号。辅音矩阵有 13 个部位、9 种方式、66 个入口。
8dfd97de16a572c892a77ab2404cbc0e85769a94.translation: extIPA covers additional articulation, partial voicing, rhythm, uncertain passages, and external sounds. Its consonant matrix has 13 places, 9 manners, and 66 entries.

4355c4b34c2d35d0c1fa4afd6c86440b0c7124cc.source: extIPA 辅音矩阵、原表阴影格及上方四个分区按钮。
4355c4b34c2d35d0c1fa4afd6c86440b0c7124cc.translation: extIPA consonant matrix with shaded cells from the source chart and four section buttons above.

d854f43c57c5eecf210b09837d34e9f4cb47d5fe.source: 选 <s id="0">extIPA → 辅音图表</s>，按方式和部位定位。灰色格表示原表判定不可能的构音，右半灰格表示浊音一侧受限；普通空格表示未收录。
d854f43c57c5eecf210b09837d34e9f4cb47d5fe.translation: Choose <s id="0">extIPA → Consonant chart</s> and locate by manner and place. Gray cells mark articulations judged impossible in the source chart. A gray right half limits the voiced side; ordinary empty cells mean unlisted entries.

f0cd0d66ba8922bf424ca7db6493f29dd66adf8f.source: 在<s id="0">附加符号与发声</s>找独立附加号、发声方向与例示；在<s id="1">节奏与其他</s>找范围工具，先选正文再点。
f0cd0d66ba8922bf424ca7db6493f29dd66adf8f.translation: Use <s id="0">Diacritics and phonation</s> for standalone marks, phonation direction, and examples. Find span tools under <s id="1">Rhythm and other</s>; select text first.

f9299b16be4f35a627d7241e4c8d476250287375.source: <s id="0">补充与旧版</s>分开列现行组合与旧记号。输入前右键核对表版和实际字符。
f9299b16be4f35a627d7241e4c8d476250287375.translation: <s id="0">Supplementary and historical</s> separates current combinations from older symbols. Right-click to check edition and actual characters before inserting.

1da0c205575a984b5e0475c3141bc128ffd35a46.translation: Contents of the four extIPA pages

5dddf98129ca1ef206a5b3290b3ab5a9ce3b145c.source: 额外辅音 66 项，分别核对清/浊成员。
5dddf98129ca1ef206a5b3290b3ab5a9ce3b145c.translation: 66 additional consonant entries; check voiceless and voiced members separately.

71a4637e84b09f9d90376968327638581d2a781a.source: 附加符号 26、发声与送气 32、构音部位独立附加号 12。半括号方向有用途区别，先看详情。
71a4637e84b09f9d90376968327638581d2a781a.translation: 26 diacritics, 32 phonation and aspiration entries, and 12 standalone place diacritics. Half-bracket direction matters; read details first.

22044c78761a6bf56570808c76f811aac816b79d.source: 节奏/响度/速度 26，不确定性/无声构音/外来噪声 23，其他声音 18。范围工具包围选区，标签与完整例示按实际输入写入。
22044c78761a6bf56570808c76f811aac816b79d.translation: Rhythm/loudness/tempo 26; uncertainty/silent articulation/external noise 23; other sounds 18. Span tools wrap selections; labels and complete examples enter their actual text.

8afd610823ecd24242b61c4d3984fb3db76e7706.source: 补充构音组合 4，2002 版文献记号 2。补充组合和旧版项目都有专门提示。
8afd610823ecd24242b61c4d3984fb3db76e7706.translation: 4 supplementary articulatory combinations and 2 symbols from the 2002 literature, each with specific notices.

71da29aa7fac26ed69d0e3a237252872cdc0a3d5.source: extIPA 附加符号与发声页：附加号、发声与送气、构音部位记号分组显示，下方保留 t͡s。
71da29aa7fac26ed69d0e3a237252872cdc0a3d5.translation: extIPA Diacritics and phonation page with grouped diacritics, phonation and aspiration, and place marks. t͡s remains below.

858d61b17f9f935d58fe42843b9cef2946d4075c.source: 当前采用 <s id="0">ICPLA 2025 表</s>，2013 年中文论文讨论的是 2002 版。旧名可用于检索，解释要对照所列版本；部分去鼻化与 VoQS 去鼻化声也需分别查看。
858d61b17f9f935d58fe42843b9cef2946d4075c.translation: The current chart is <s id="0">ICPLA 2025</s>; the 2013 Chinese paper discusses the 2002 edition. Older names are searchable, but interpret them against the stated edition. Partial denasalization and VoQS denasalized voice also require separate checking.

b7ff0caec1504bde566f5af26247676c36673c9d.source: VoQS 直接分类展示，无额外分区页。56 项原表术语采用王天恒双语译表，另有 9 个数字、括号、范围和例句入口。悬停介绍逐项说明发声特点、符号构成与相近标签的区别，重点区分耳语、耳语声、气声、嘎裂及嘎裂声。室襞性发声也称假声带发声，复音也称双音调嗓音，可在解释中对照理解。
b7ff0caec1504bde566f5af26247676c36673c9d.translation: VoQS shows categories directly without extra section pages. Its 56 original chart terms use Wang Tianheng's bilingual translation, plus 9 entries for numbers, braces, spans, and examples. Hover descriptions explain phonation, notation, and distinctions, especially whisper, whispery voice, breathy voice, creak, and creaky voice. Ventricular phonation is also called false-vocal-fold phonation, and diplophonia is also called double-pitched voice; compare these in the explanations.

5927a0f8b264f9d28ba657b7b26a7d6e532b604c.source: VoQS 的发声类型、喉上形态、气流类型与范围、程度工具。
5927a0f8b264f9d28ba657b7b26a7d6e532b604c.translation: VoQS phonation types, supralaryngeal configurations, airstream types, spans, and degree tools.

2a9a2d5c562a35e0bd262632fcadd9afbaff00cc.source: 选 <s id="0">VoQS</s>，按发声类型、喉上形态、气流类型等分组找条目。
2a9a2d5c562a35e0bd262632fcadd9afbaff00cc.translation: Choose <s id="0">VoQS</s> and find items grouped by phonation type, supralaryngeal configuration, or airstream type.

76e9040b38a906d7da67d10717f0332c1f47d558.source: <s id="0">右键看详情</s>，核对相近标签。深色写入单项，浅色输入完整例句。
76e9040b38a906d7da67d10717f0332c1f47d558.translation: <s id="0">Right-click for details</s> to distinguish similar labels. Dark buttons insert single items; light buttons insert complete examples.

7f97af52c7fe225eef487f68b488b47bffb0f0e2.source: 标记一段音质时，<s id="0">先选中正文，再点带标签的大括号工具</s>。程度数字只写数字，不会判断强度。
7f97af52c7fe225eef487f68b488b47bffb0f0e2.translation: To mark a voice-quality span, <s id="0">select text first, then click a labeled brace tool</s>. Degree buttons enter only numbers and do not judge intensity.

d9eb9edefbaa98f3b8e966b83137d1fe36d0aba1.source: 颊气流、肺部吸气言语、食管气流、气管–食管言语。
d9eb9edefbaa98f3b8e966b83137d1fe36d0aba1.translation: Buccal airstream, pulmonic ingressive speech, oesophageal airstream, and tracheo-oesophageal speech.

05aeb0d36a22cfb39d41e042bdadee9cc8673201.source: 常态浊声、假声、耳语、嘎裂、气声、糙声及组合。
05aeb0d36a22cfb39d41e042bdadee9cc8673201.translation: Modal voice, falsetto, whisper, creak, breathy voice, harsh voice, and combinations.

24d9a50e7caecd67342ddb07e7237bb3e9416dcc.source: 喉位偏高声、喉位偏低声。

751c5347f29c45c8bab5f81d42365a331ec09543.source: 唇部 4、舌部 12、软腭 2、颌和舌的形态 6，按范围设置解释。
751c5347f29c45c8bab5f81d42365a331ec09543.translation: Lips 4, tongue 12, velum 2, and jaw/tongue configurations 6, explained as settings across a span.

423b31e4d3ff672705eb833f036af5b9d4b987e6.source: 程度 1/2/3 表示相对较弱/中等/较强；范围包围正文，完整例句整串写入。
423b31e4d3ff672705eb833f036af5b9d4b987e6.translation: Degrees 1/2/3 mean relatively weak/moderate/strong. Spans wrap text; complete examples insert whole strings.

d2755181ac6c3edb6b514275d09b4467354b6266.source: 例如选中 aː，点<s id="0">糙声范围 {V! … V!}</s>，得到 {V! aː V!}，aː 仍选中，可继续核对或嵌套。程度数字不对应统一分贝值、声学阈值或病理严重度。
d2755181ac6c3edb6b514275d09b4467354b6266.translation: For example, select aː and click <s id="0">Harsh voice span {V! … V!}</s> to obtain {V! aː V!}. aː stays selected for checking or nesting. Degree numbers do not correspond to universal decibel values, acoustic thresholds, or pathological severity.

5e2b6d48b9e78a6e4af770751f80b8230b51d835.source: 糙声范围详情展开，文本 aː 位于左右 V! 标签之间并保持选中。
5e2b6d48b9e78a6e4af770751f80b8230b51d835.translation: Harsh voice span details open with aː between V! labels on both sides and still selected.

fa4a429b066d7d41f6ae7f01a1bada862fc65745.source: 要给 a 加鼻化，<s id="0">光标放到 a 后并取消选区</s>，再点深色 ◌̃。虚线圆只显示位置，不会写入。<s id="1">有选区时，附加号会替换整个选区。</s>操作不对就撤销，再重新放光标。
fa4a429b066d7d41f6ae7f01a1bada862fc65745.translation: To nasalize a, <s id="0">place the cursor after a and clear the selection</s>, then click dark ◌̃. The dotted circle only shows placement and is not inserted. <s id="1">With a selection, the diacritic replaces the entire selection.</s> If this is wrong, undo and reposition the cursor.

ca93e88f0981754a496ecd69a4d198ccdbed2f95.source: ã 保持选中，底部显示 U+0061 与 U+0303；虚线圆未写入正文。
ca93e88f0981754a496ecd69a4d198ccdbed2f95.translation: ã remains selected, and U+0061 and U+0303 appear below. No dotted circle is inserted in the text.

0007f3a5d6c9b696b841a2e3059a8bce81559354.source: 浅色 ẽ、b̤ 或音质例句会整串写入。显示与写入不一致时，查看详情中的<s id="0">实际输入</s>。
0007f3a5d6c9b696b841a2e3059a8bce81559354.translation: Light ẽ, b̤, or voice-quality examples insert complete strings. If display and inserted text differ, check <s id="0">Actual input</s> in the details.

53cea210150374598035056dd16128fa5ffa619c.source: 输入 t 和 s，<s id="0">恰好选中两个字素</s>。一个字母及其附加号通常一起算一个字素。
53cea210150374598035056dd16128fa5ffa619c.translation: Enter t and s and <s id="0">select exactly two graphemes</s>. A letter and its diacritics usually form one grapheme.

e262cfd6e7ebc13ad4cd0e74d1a56a08ef806276.source: 点 <s id="0">IPA → 其他符号与连音线</s>中的深色上连音线或下连音线，得到 t͡s 或 t͜s；extIPA 滑动构音工具同样连接两个字素。
e262cfd6e7ebc13ad4cd0e74d1a56a08ef806276.translation: Click the dark upper or lower tie-bar tool under <s id="0">IPA → Other symbols and tie bars</s> to obtain t͡s or t͜s. extIPA sliding-articulation tools also join two graphemes.

4a8cda11e26a6e38d38612dec3ff8bafffb70fec.source: 选区数量不对会提示且不改正文。重新选择，或点浅色完整例示。
4a8cda11e26a6e38d38612dec3ff8bafffb70fec.translation: An incorrect selection count produces a message without changing text. Reselect, or click a light complete example.

f375e455d19fdb5b6001e76d894fd5cadcf6a912.source: 下方 t͡s 已选中，底部可见连接字符 U+0361，右侧是连音线区域。
f375e455d19fdb5b6001e76d894fd5cadcf6a912.translation: t͡s is selected below, with joining character U+0361 visible in the bottom status and the tie-bar area on the right.

0beffe31c4555690c65d956a14af870bce0aa34a.source: 红框标出深色上、下连音线工具，旁边较浅的按钮为完整例示。
0beffe31c4555690c65d956a14af870bce0aa34a.translation: Red boxes mark dark upper and lower tie-bar tools. The lighter buttons beside them are complete examples.

33a5fd7a2be6f48892000d23b4e19ba21d7957ee.source: 上、下连音线区域局部图，深色工具与浅色完整例示并列，红框标出工具入口
33a5fd7a2be6f48892000d23b4e19ba21d7957ee.translation: Close-up of upper and lower tie-bar area: dark tools beside light complete examples, with red boxes marking tool entries.

3e6c0d627543382614b633c2b91c7835a7202f3e.source: <s id="0">没有选区时，连接工具只在光标处插入连接字符。</s>它不会自动寻找前后字母。插入与替换会保护字母及其附加号的边界，仍需核对转写。
3e6c0d627543382614b633c2b91c7835a7202f3e.translation: <s id="0">Without a selection, a joining tool only inserts its joining character at the cursor.</s> It does not find surrounding letters automatically. Insertion and replacement protect letter–diacritic boundaries, but the transcription still needs checking.

6b26e97096b768fdbab0a4d0812d5e8c7d35fe9f.source: <s id="0">先选中文字，再点范围工具</s>，原文保留在左右标签之间。extIPA 可用 {f … f}、{allegro … allegro}，VoQS 可用 {…}、{V! … V!}。没有选区时生成空范围，光标放在内部。继续包围选区可嵌套，最后核对每组起止标签。
6b26e97096b768fdbab0a4d0812d5e8c7d35fe9f.translation: <s id="0">Select text first, then click a span tool</s> to retain it between matching labels. extIPA offers {f … f} and {allegro … allegro}; VoQS offers {…} and {V! … V!}. Without a selection, an empty span is created with the cursor inside. Wrapping again creates nesting; check each opening and closing label.

e9b3532a703d72f3917f9bc681ca9705c1c1a568.source: 较响范围包住 pa ta，形成 {f pa ta f}，内部文字仍选中。
e9b3532a703d72f3917f9bc681ca9705c1c1a568.translation: A loudness span wraps pa ta as {f pa ta f}; the internal text remains selected.

a7a94a5e32798a3acaf16a116d79ee9cc716e4e9.source: 中文输入法请<s id="0">先完成选词，再点符号</s>，否则会提示结束当前组合。手动输入、粘贴、符号点击和清空共用撤销历史，一次输入法提交算一步。历史保留最多 120 步，并有累计容量限制，正文不会因此截断；重开后不恢复撤销历史。
a7a94a5e32798a3acaf16a116d79ee9cc716e4e9.translation: With a Chinese input method, <s id="0">finish choosing characters before clicking a symbol</s>; otherwise a message asks you to finish composition. Typing, pasting, symbol clicks, and clearing share undo history. One input-method commit counts as one step. History holds at most 120 steps with a cumulative-size limit, without truncating text. Reopening does not restore history.

2e8c504f9937f143140433ad444b30cd59c4c6f7.source: 悬停介绍默认开启。停留后可读含义、用法、区别、码位与短来源。浮窗会在符号附近避开指针；<s id="0">移入浮窗可继续阅读和滚动</s>，离开自动收起。
2e8c504f9937f143140433ad444b30cd59c4c6f7.translation: Hover descriptions are enabled by default. Pause to read meaning, usage, distinctions, code points, and short sources. The popover stays near the symbol while avoiding the pointer. <s id="0">Move into it to continue reading and scrolling</s>; it collapses after you leave.

145d92cd36904613532767976459bf3bbb8ae4de.source: 关闭悬停后，<s id="0">右键符号或 Tab 聚焦后按 Alt+Enter</s>仍可展开详情，并查看实际输入、例示与别名。留意组合输入示例、旧版文献记号和文本替代提示。来源链接需主动点击。
145d92cd36904613532767976459bf3bbb8ae4de.translation: With hovering off, <s id="0">right-click a symbol or focus with Tab and press Alt+Enter</s> to open details, actual input, examples, and aliases. Note combined-input examples, historical-literature symbols, and text-substitution notices. Source links require an explicit click.

d933ab5e37e8edbcf35385a1e2b22ad56650f7ea.source: 点击播放暂时禁用。鼠标悬停在此按钮上可看到演示内容正在创作中，将在后续更新中开放的提示。当前点击音标用于插入文字。
